title: SAP Concur Receipt Image
description: Schema for an SAP Concur Receipt Image — a digital receipt or document image attached to an expense entry for audit and compliance purposes.

ID.description: The unique identifier of the receipt image

EntryID.description: The expense entry ID this receipt is associated with

ReceiptImageURL.description: Temporary presigned URL to download the receipt image file

IsRequired.description: Whether expense policy requires a receipt for the associated entry

ReceiptType.description: Type of receipt (e.g., physical, e-receipt, digital tax invoice)

UploadDate.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the receipt image was uploaded

FileType.description: MIME type of the receipt image file

FileSizeBytes.description: Size of the receipt image file in bytes

URI.description: Full URI for the receipt image resource
